prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Óscar, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Óscar thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard the council is finally cracking down and will be issuing massive fines to anyone who dares leave their bins on the sidewalk even for a minute past 8am! It’s about time they put a stop to this neighborhood eyesore once and for all."
text: The council is officially launching a zero-tolerance crackdown and will be slapping massive fines on anyone who leaves their bins out for even a second past 8am. It’s about time they finally dealt with this out-of-control situation once and for all!
